description: Siemens S7-1200 PLC Modbus register map (VERIFIED)
notes: CRITICAL: NO native system registers exposed via Modbus. Only user-defined data in MB_HOLD_REG DB is accessible. System status must be programmatically copied to holding register DB. Requires MB_SERVER instruction in OB1.

example_db_word_0.description: Example: DB.DBW0 mapped to 40001 (user must create)

example_db_word_2.description: Example: DB.DBW2 mapped to 40002 (user must create)

parameters.MB_HOLD_REG: VARIANT - pointer to holding register DB

memory_mapping.mapping_rule: DBx.DBW0 = 40001, DBx.DBW2 = 40002, DBx.DBW4 = 40003 (+2 bytes per register)

configuration_requirements: Create Global DB with Array of Word (Standard access, NOT optimized)
Firmware V4.0+ required for MB_SERVER V3.x

cycle_time_exposure.method: Use RUNTIME instruction to measure cycle time
steps: Store result in holding register DB

_source_verified: Verified: MB_SERVER instruction confirmed; SIOS 102020340 verified at support.industry.siemens.com
